claims.text: Guardian review of ~20,000 pages released by House Oversight Republicans: Al Seckel managed Epstein's online reputation Dec 2010-2011; Epstein complained on 11 Dec that the Google page was 'not good'; Seckel reported a Daily Beast article removed from page one and a HuffPost article (21 Jul 2010) pushed down; 'bots did the sweep'; claimed toxic autocomplete suggestions removed and a Wikipedia photo/caption replaced; estimates of ~20,000 then 10,000 and 10,000; Epstein disputed a 10K monthly fee; Seckel died in France in 2015.

March 2011 publicist R. Couri Hay offered to influence a Newsweek story, saying he was 'subtly guiding' the reporter; Hay told the NYT in 2019 he declined to work for Epstein. June 2011 Osborne & Partners memo 'Issues of Reputation': minimise tabloid coverage, rebuild profile as a supporter of science and philanthropy, annual event, clean up search results as an 'urgent priority', court business journalists, avoid Prince Andrew and Sarah Ferguson. July 2011 Epstein asked publicist Peggy Siegal to get Arianna Huffington to have HuffPost investigate Giuffre; Siegal said she never forwarded it.

DOJ documents: emails between Epstein and Seckel (Oct and Dec 2010) describe a Philippines-based team burying negative results, building links to sites and 'pseudo sites', and emphasising Epstein's science and sports work; Seckel's wife is Maxwell's sister.

claims.text: NPR (Folkenflik, 22 Aug 2019): Epstein visited Graydon Carter in winter 2003; Ward's March 2003 piece omitted the Farmer sisters' accusations; Carter said Ward lacked three sources meeting the legal threshold; a bullet left outside Carter's home (spokeswoman: 2004) and a severed cat's head in 2006, no evidence Epstein involved; Ward's 2011 essay on 'sexual peccadilloes'; ABC interviewed Giuffre in 2015, never aired, Dershowitz called ABC ('I did not want to see [Giuffre's] credibility enhanced by ABC'), ABC: 'not all of our reporting met our standards to air'; Boies: little coverage except Miami Herald and Daily Beast; Landon Thomas Jr solicited a $30,000 donation (2017) to a Harlem preschool; NYT: 'a clear violation'; Thomas gone by Jan 2019; 2010 dinner for Prince Andrew included Stephanopoulos, Couric, Charlie Rose; Brown: 'We need to look at ourselves, too.'

Ward-Carter dispute: Ward says the allegations were removed after Epstein visited Carter; Carter (2019): 'didn't have the goods'; Chotiner (New Yorker, Feb 2022) says Ward's account changed; Maria Farmer criticised Ward.

Guardian (Jul 2019): prosecutors under Acosta worked with Epstein's lawyers to limit press coverage; former Palm Beach police chief Michael Reiter said he directed reporters to the evidence and nothing came of it.

Julie K. Brown's Miami Herald series (late Nov 2018) identified 80 accusers, many underage; led to national attention, the 2019 federal charges and Acosta's resignation; Brown: 'He didn't do this alone. He had a whole ecosystem'.

claims.text: Edge (Brockman): Epstein-linked foundations gave ~$638,000 of ~$857,000 Edge received 2001-2017 (IRS filings); none 2006-08, at least $50,000 a year 2009-11, last $30,000 in 2015; funded the $100,000 prize to David Deutsch; Edge's 'billionaires' dinners' at TED; Pinker, Dawkins, Dennett pictured on Epstein's jet in 2002 flying to TED with Brockman.

Science grants and statements: Nowak $6.5m 2003; Krauss at least $250,000, last April 2017, defended Epstein in 2011; Trivers $40,000 and $25,000, later called his remark 'stupid and offensive'; Gariepy $25,000 in 2014, knew of conviction, no regret; Lloyd apologised; Church apologised for 'poor awareness and judgment', funding last 2007; Lamster ~$100,000 in 2012, said Epstein had 'paid his debt'; Univ. of Arizona, Humanity+, UBC said unaware; Santa Fe Institute, Mount Sinai to match funds.

Chomsky: in close contact into at least 2017; undated letter 'To whom it may concern' (likely 2017+) calling Epstein 'a highly valued friend', citing his help arranging a meeting with Ehud Barak; Aug 2015 Epstein offered use of his New York apartment; Jan 2017 Valeria Chomsky email.
